dist/site-pages.js.scope: Article learning contract links each mapped chapter to its matching 16:9 course scene (31 chapters, scene ids checked against course reading targets); no chapter relationship, prerequisite or route change.

dist/study-guides.js.scope: Outline adds the 30-scene overview course entry; interview cards link 12 questions to the matching course scene. Interview content and chapter links unchanged.

dist/curriculum.css.scope: Styles for the resources-page course banner and interview link group only.

README.md.scope: Documents course narration audio, the export command and the Range-request fallback.

dist/static-reading-version.js.scope: Regenerated by render-pages after the reviewed source changes.

dist/reader-runtime-manifest.json.scope: Regenerated by render-pages after the reviewed source changes.

src/course/index.html.scope: Play-course control with P shortcut, speed cycle button, voice on by default.

src/course/course.css.scope: Clickable subtitle clauses and step-rail dashes (hover/focus states).

src/course/player.js.scope: Studio audio engine: plays dist/course-audio tracks synced to timelines.json beats, seeks on manual navigation, rolls over to the next lesson, keeps playback rate across tracks, falls back to whole-track Blob when the server lacks HTTP Range, and to Web Speech when audio is missing.

scripts/check-courses.cjs.scope: Adds narration track checks: one track per lesson plus overview, byte sizes, ordered beats that target existing scenes and steps.

review_scope.feature: Synced studio narration for the animated courses and course entry links from chapters, outline, interview and resources pages
review_scope.verification: Exported timelines matched the live player clause structure and text for all 31 tracks; real-Chrome playback covered start, speed change, manual seek, lesson rollover, pause, mute, overview and Season 2 deep link.
review_scope.not_verified: Human listening review of the Tingting voice was not repeated; mobile Safari autoplay behaviour not tested.
